content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy promise simplicity but deliver dependency. They host your product, process payments, and handle delivery—until they don’t. When Stripe or PayPal blocks your region, these platforms become useless. They offer no alternative payment methods, no ownership of your data, and no way to migrate. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) flips this model. It gives you six sovereign commerce stacks, each built on open infrastructure. GitHub Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. Supabase stores orders. NOWPayments processes crypto payments. You own every component. No platform locks you in. No geographic restrictions apply. This is not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure designed for creators in restricted regions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional platforms rely on Stripe and PayPal for payments. When these gateways block your country, the platform fails. They might suggest manual workarounds like bank transfers or third-party processors, but these are slow, insecure, and unreliable. COREMERCH’s stacks bypass this entirely. NOWPayments integrates 300+ cryptocurrencies, with no KYC and no buyer account required. Payments confirm on-chain automatically, triggering instant product delivery. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep fees under $0.10 per transaction. This architecture removes geographic barriers. Whether you’re in Kenya, Ghana, or Zimbabwe, the stack works the same. No platform decides whether you can sell. You own the infrastructure, so you control it.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms charge 5-10% per transaction, plus hidden fees for currency conversion or chargebacks. When Stripe or PayPal is unavailable, these costs skyrocket. COREMERCH’s stacks cut fees to the bone. NOWPayments charges 0.5% for crypto processing. Hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages is free. Backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script is free. Order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets is free. File delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 is free. The only cost is the stack itself—a one-time $197 for the Complete Builder Kit. After deployment, your operational costs are near zero. Payments confirm in minutes, not days. No platform takes a cut. No geographic fees apply.
Conventional platforms fail in restricted regions. COREMERCH’s stacks do not.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your data, your customer relationships, and your storefront. They can shut you down at any time, with no recourse. COREMERCH’s stacks give you full ownership. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure. Your storefront lives on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Your orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Your files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Automation is built in. When a payment confirms on-chain, NOWPayments triggers a webhook that delivers the product instantly. No manual intervention required. This is infrastructure sovereignty—not renting, but owning. Your stack operates independently of any platform. Your business runs on your terms.

COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit is the only architecture designed for your situation. It removes geographic barriers, cuts fees to the bone, and gives you full ownership. If you’re selling fewer than three products, start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97). If you need advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, choose the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). For full flexibility, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all six stacks and seven templates. Deploy in 48 hours. Own your infrastructure. Sell without borders.
